purpose: Six existing finished compositions for biome BGM, selected from the original composer's official catalog.
author: Kevin MacLeod
validation: All six official original MP3 files were downloaded with HTTP range/length checks and decoded completely to PCM by macOS CoreAudio. Duration, RMS and peak were measured. No listening or in-game transition validation was performed.

notes: Preload and successfully start the next track before fading the current track; keep the current track if the next fails.
Use two independent music playback voices, retain per-track positions, and avoid resetting on every terrain boundary.
The gain values are only RMS alignment hints, not LUFS or verified perceived loudness.
Full compositions have intros/outros; seamless transition and loop behavior must be auditioned in-game.
